provenance.notes: Vocabulary and short keyword glossary for the effect DSL. Definitions are our own <=1-sentence paraphrases of the official rulebook / master reference sheet; no card or rulebook prose is copied. Numeric movement costs are derived from the upstream engine's enums.rs and are NOT printed in the extracted rulebook text (the Day/Night board is an image), so they are tagged unverified.

keywords.name: Fortified
keywords.short: In the ranged/siege phase only siege attacks can be used against it; double fortified if it also defends a fortified site.

keywords.name: Unfortified
keywords.short: Ignores all site fortifications.

keywords.name: Elusive
keywords.short: Has a higher armor value unless all of its attacks are blocked.

keywords.name: Arcane Immunity
keywords.short: Unaffected by non-attack/non-block effects; attack-modifying effects still apply.

keywords.name: Defend X
keywords.short: The first enemy you attack has its armor increased by X until end of combat.

keywords.name: Summon
keywords.short: At start of the block phase a random brown token replaces it for blocking/damage, then is discarded.

keywords.name: Summon (green)
keywords.short: Summon variant that draws a green (orc) token instead of brown; upstream-only encoding.

keywords.name: Swift
keywords.short: Needs twice its attack value in block to be blocked.

keywords.name: Brutal
keywords.short: If unblocked it deals twice its attack value as damage.

keywords.name: Poison
keywords.short: A wounded unit gets two wounds; a hero also puts one extra wound into the discard pile.

keywords.name: Paralyze
keywords.short: A wounded unit is destroyed; a hero discards all non-wound cards from hand.

keywords.name: Assassination
keywords.short: Unblocked damage cannot be assigned to units and must be taken by the hero.

keywords.name: Cumbersome
keywords.short: In the block phase move points can reduce its attack, one per point; zero counts as blocked.

keywords.name: Vampiric
keywords.short: Gains +1 armor for the rest of combat for each unit or hero wound its attacks cause.
keywords.official_ref: MK Master Reference Sheet p.2; MKUE Expansions Rulebook p.2

keywords.name: Cold Fire Attack
keywords.short: Only cold fire blocks are efficient; other blocks are halved.

keywords.name: Fire Attack
keywords.short: Only ice and cold fire blocks are efficient; other blocks are halved.

keywords.name: Ice Attack
keywords.short: Only fire and cold fire blocks are efficient; other blocks are halved.

keywords.name: Ambush
keywords.short: Expansion ability: can attack from up to two spaces away when provoked.
keywords.official_ref: MKUE Expansions Rulebook p.2 (not in base-game data)

keywords.name: Pursuit
keywords.short: Expansion ability: moves one space toward the marked hero after their movement.
keywords.official_ref: MKUE Expansions Rulebook p.2 (not in base-game data)

keywords.name: Physical Resistance
keywords.short: Reduces damage from physical attacks; also resists physical attacks in PvP.

keywords.name: Fire Resistance
keywords.short: Reduces fire attack damage and ignores non-attack effects of red cards/powered abilities.

keywords.name: Ice Resistance
keywords.short: Reduces ice attack damage and ignores non-attack effects of blue cards/powered abilities.

keywords.name: Ranged Attack
keywords.short: Attacks in the ranged & siege phase; inefficient against fortified enemies.

keywords.name: Siege Attack
keywords.short: Ranged-phase attack that ignores fortification; cannot be played sideways.

keywords.name: Block
keywords.short: Points spent in the block phase to stop one enemy attack; elemental multipliers apply.

keywords.name: Attack
keywords.short: Points spent in the attack phase to destroy one enemy; total must reach its armor.

keywords.name: Healing
keywords.short: Discards wound cards from hand or discard pile at the given rate.

keywords.name: Mana Token
keywords.short: One-shot mana of a colour; from the Source, crystals, skills or card effects.

keywords.name: Mana Crystal
keywords.short: Stored mana in the inventory; spent to power one card and consumed.

keywords.name: Fame
keywords.short: Victory points and level-up currency.

keywords.name: Reputation
keywords.short: Track that adjusts interaction costs and conquest reputation penalties/bonuses.

keywords.name: Influence
keywords.short: Points spent at inhabited sites to recruit, heal and buy cards.

keywords.name: Hand Limit
keywords.short: Maximum hand size when drawing at round start, shown on the level token.

keywords.name: Command Token
keywords.short: One token per allowed unit; assigned to a unit while it is used.

keywords.name: Wound
keywords.short: Unplayable card that clogs the deck; also marks wounded units.

keywords.name: Tactic
keywords.short: Per-round card that sets turn order and may grant a special effect.

keywords.name: Deed Card
keywords.short: Umbrella term for Action, Spell, Artifact and Wound cards.

keywords.name: Shield Token
keywords.short: Marks fame/reputation position and conquered sites on the map.
